description: Source code for Android-specific SSL platform key handling in Chromium, implementing a delegate for private key operations including signing and algorithm preferences.

classes.name: SSLPlatformKeyAndroid
classes.description: Android-specific implementation of SSL private key delegate, handling signing operations and algorithm preferences.

methods.name: GetJavaAlgorithm
methods.description: Maps internal algorithm identifiers to Java signature algorithm strings.

methods.name: SSLPlatformKeyAndroid
methods.description: Constructor initializing the key, provider name, and algorithm preferences.

methods.name: GetProviderName
methods.description: Returns the provider name of the key.

methods.name: GetAlgorithmPreferences
methods.description: Returns the list of preferred algorithms.

methods.name: Sign
methods.description: Signs input data with the private key using specified algorithm, with fallback for RSA PSS.

methods.name: SignPSSFallback
methods.description: Performs RSA PSS signing fallback by hashing and padding the input.
